title: Pocket Queue
overview: A small in-memory message queue with an HTTP API, written in TypeScript on Express.

verdict.reason: The server and leases work, but there is no acknowledge route, no persistence and no tests.

features.name: Message leases
features.howItWorks: A claimed message is leased for 30 seconds and goes back to the queue if it is not acknowledged in time.
designDecisions: Leases expire on the next claim instead of with a background timer, to keep the code small.
features.failureHandling: A stalled consumer does not lose the message; it returns to the queue when the lease expires.

features.name: Acknowledge route
features.howItWorks: The README describes removing a leased message, but no route for it exists in the code.

numbers.meaning: Lease length in seconds (LEASE_SECONDS in the code).

doNotClaim: That messages survive a restart: queues live in memory only.
